images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Style: atmospheric lofi scenic photography with a subtle painterly softness, fine analog film grain, nostalgic stillness, muted colors, believable scenery, no people, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. One standalone image, no collage or borders. Wide 16:9 website letter background. Rainy train-window ocean view: looking from inside a quiet coastal train through a rain-speckled window toward a calm ocean and hazy distant coastline. Window frame confined to outer edges. Central 60% should be uncluttered, softly shaded mid-dark blue ocean and haze so white letter text can overlay it. Gentle subdued reflections, dreamy calm.
